title: Flashcards: Amphibians, scientific names
intro: Flip each card about amphibians. Mark the ones you knew; the others come back sooner. Every answer shows its source.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the red-eyed tree frog?
cards.explain: The red-eyed tree frog is Agalychnis callidryas.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the axolotl?
What is the scientific name of the Japanese giant salamander?
cards.explain: The Japanese giant salamander is Andrias japonicus.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the European fire-bellied toad?
cards.explain: The European fire-bellied toad is Bombina bombina.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the hellbender?
What is the scientific name of the yellow-banded poison dart frog?
cards.explain: The yellow-banded poison dart frog is Dendrobates leucomelas.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the dyeing dart frog?
cards.explain: The dyeing dart frog is Dendrobates tinctorius.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the Hula Painted Frog?
cards.explain: The Hula Painted Frog is Latonia nigriventer.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the Common Spadefoot?
cards.explain: The Common Spadefoot is Pelobates fuscus.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the marsh frog?
cards.explain: The marsh frog is Pelophylax ridibundus.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the golden poison frog?
cards.explain: The golden poison frog is Phyllobates terribilis.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the Surinam toad?
cards.explain: The Surinam toad is Pipa pipa.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the Agile frog?
cards.explain: The Agile frog is Rana dalmatina.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the Australian green tree frog?
cards.explain: The Australian green tree frog is Ranoidea caerulea.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the Mexican burrowing toad?
cards.explain: The Mexican burrowing toad is Rhinophrynus dorsalis.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the alpine salamander?
cards.explain: The alpine salamander is Salamandra atra.
